sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Meya City Stunt is a racing game that requires skill, strategy, and a bit of luck. Players take on the role of a driver navigating a sports car through the city streets, performing stunts and jumps to earn points and rewards. The game features a range of challenging levels, each with its own unique obstacles and objectives. From navigating through tight tunnels to performing high-speed jumps over traffic, Meya City Stunt requires a keen eye and quick reflexes to succeed.

One of the standout features of Meya City Stunt is its simple yet intuitive controls. Players can use the W, A, S, and D keys to steer the car, the F key to activate nitro, and the Space key to use the handbrake. The game also features a range of camera controls, allowing players to switch between different views to suit their preferences. This makes it easy for players to get started and focus on the gameplay, rather than worrying about complicated controls.

The game also features a range of power-ups and bonuses, including coins, boosters, and shields. These can be used to enhance the player's performance, giving them an edge in competition or helping them overcome challenging obstacles. With its engaging gameplay mechanics and variety of challenges, Meya City Stunt is a game that will keep you coming back for more.
